name: Meeting Recorder
description: Record a meeting in the browser (shared tab audio plus microphone) and transcribe it with a faster-whisper endpoint you run (loopback by default), cut at pauses and checked for repetition loops.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: WHISPER_URL
env_vars.description: OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint. Defaults to the faster-whisper-server bundle on loopback :8004.

env_vars.name: WHISPER_MODEL
env_vars.description: Model name passed to that endpoint.

env_vars.name: WHISPER_FALLBACK_URL
env_vars.description: Optional second transcription endpoint. A chunk the primary cannot answer, or answers only with a suspected repetition loop, is retried here. Unset means one endpoint, as before.

env_vars.name: WHISPER_FALLBACK_MODEL
env_vars.description: Model name for the fallback endpoint. Defaults to WHISPER_MODEL.

env_vars.name: MEETING_RECORDER_EXPORT_DIR
env_vars.description: Optional. A directory that also receives a dated markdown copy of every transcript, for grepping or for a git repo.

notes: Needs ffmpeg on the host and a transcription endpoint (the faster-whisper-server bundle is the intended pairing; it is CPU-only and loopback-bound). No port of its own: the capture page and its upload endpoints ride the gateway through the panel and panelRoutes, so recordings inherit the dashboard's session auth. A browser only hands over tab audio in a secure context, so reach the dashboard over HTTPS (Tailscale Serve, a reverse proxy, or localhost).
